Success stories

Real journeys. New possibilities.

#FromHereToThrive celebrates the newcomers, volunteers, mentors and partners who make up the CIASO community – in their own words.

Share this page: LinkedIn (opens in a new tab) Facebook (opens in a new tab)

All stories

Testimonials are shared in participants’ own words, lightly shortened where marked with “…”.

#FromHereToThrive

Share your journey.

Has CIASO been part of your journey – as a participant, volunteer, mentor or partner? Your story can show another newcomer what is possible.

We will always ask for your permission before publishing, agree with you how you’d like to be named, and let you review your story first. You can ask us to remove it at any time.

Share Your Story

How we tell each story

  1. Where you startedYour arrival and first steps in Canada.
  2. The challengeWhat you faced – or the opportunity you saw.
  3. How CIASO helpedThe support, people and programs involved.
  4. Your progressWhat changed for you and your family.
  5. What’s nextWhat this means for your future.

Take the next step

Your next chapter starts with one step.

Whether you are beginning your journey in Canada, exploring career opportunities, looking for community connections, or hoping to make a difference, CIASO can help you explore the next step.

  • Get SupportTell us what you need help with
  • Join a ProgramWorkshops and upcoming events
  • VolunteerGive your time and skills
  • Partner With UsEmployers, schools, funders and more
  • DonateSupport newcomer families

The Canada Integration and Settlement Organization (CIASO) is an Alberta-based nonprofit connecting newcomers and families to the support, skills, community and opportunities they need to build a future in Canada.

From arrival to opportunity.
From opportunity to impact.
